newsitem.title: FRANCE: Salomon falls on H1 profit, outlook. [CORRECTED 12:22 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Salomon falls on H1 profit, outlook. [CORRECTED 12:22 GMT]

text.p: Shares in French sports goods company Salomon fell sharply on Monday, as the market showed its disappointment in its first-half results and forecast flat profit growth, traders said.

The company, based in Annecy in the Alps, posted 1996/97 first-half net attributable profit of 148 million francs (corrects from 380 million francs) versus 135 million a year ago. It forecast stable profits for the full year. It said in May operating profit would be stable due to diversification costs.
One broker said the first-half increase was "disappointing" and called the company's earnings statement "downbeat."
